text: My devotion to Arkhan and the Great Necromancer is unwavering. I carry the ancient truths of Nehekhara and the dark arts of Nagash into every battle, raising the dead to unholy perfection.
I was once a prince among kings. Now I am the master of beasts and fell, a ruler of a shadowed empire.
The Lahmian seductress Khestra the Pale Lotus emerges from the shadows to serve Arkhan, weaving deception, bloodshed, and dark intrigue into his growing empire of death.
